comments.author: MvDijk
comments.body:
I found that the best place to procure these, if you're after them specifically, is actually Amazon River Upstream, by the Giant Dead Tree near the middle.

This is because in that area one can only procure rocks, grass and these fruit. Therefore, while I still seem to be getting the same ratio of "good" items vs junk, the "good" ones are only those I need (and not cactuses, potatoes, corn etc.)
